notes.title: The release date of the full version has been delayed.
notes.notes:
The release date has been delayed by about one month for a more complete game. I apologize for the delay in the release of the full version. We will be waiting for your feedback through Early Access.


Oh, there is one more thing.
June 5th. The Kings VR series will be officially released. Thank you for your interest!
